meta.title: PageSpeed Insights Report
meta.subtitle: vlncy.com
meta.device: Mobile (Emulated Moto G Power, Slow 4G throttling)

sections.text: Field data from real users over the latest 28-day period (Chrome UX Report). Overall assessment: Passed.

items.title: Render-blocking requests
items.recommendation: Defer or inline critical CSS/JS so first paint is not blocked by external requests.

items.title: Font display not optimised
items.recommendation: Add font-display: swap to web font declarations so text renders immediately with a fallback.

items.title: Forced reflow detected
items.recommendation: Batch DOM reads and writes; avoid querying layout properties immediately after DOM mutations.

items.title: Inefficient cache lifetimes
items.recommendation: Set long Cache-Control max-age headers on static assets with content-hashed filenames.

items.title: Unoptimised image delivery
items.recommendation: Serve images in modern formats (WebP/AVIF), compress, and size responsively.

items.title: Enormous network payload
items.recommendation: Reduce total transfer size; largest wins are image compression and caching above.

items.title: Main-thread work too high
items.impact: 2.3 s of main-thread work, 7 long tasks
items.recommendation: Split long JavaScript tasks and defer non-critical scripts.

items.title: Unused CSS and JavaScript
items.impact: Est savings of 65 KiB CSS + 265 KiB JS
items.recommendation: Tree-shake and code-split; remove unused rules and legacy polyfills (13 KiB legacy JS).

items.title: Images missing explicit dimensions
items.recommendation: Add width and height attributes to all img elements.

items.title: Images missing alt attributes
items.impact: Screen readers cannot describe images; also flagged under SEO
items.recommendation: Add descriptive alt text to all images (34 images affected per full crawl).

items.title: Insufficient colour contrast
items.impact: Text may be illegible for low-vision users
items.recommendation: Adjust foreground/background colours to meet WCAG AA contrast ratio (4.5:1 for body text).

items.title: Heading order not sequential
items.impact: Confusing document outline for assistive technology
items.recommendation: Ensure heading levels descend sequentially (h1 then h2 then h3, no skips).

items.title: Browser errors logged to console
items.recommendation: Investigate and resolve console errors logged during page load.

items.label: Session
items.value: Single page session, initial page load
